fusions.name: Trailing Dart
fusions.desc: Fires a dart that deals 4 damage and has a 25% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Final Run
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 18 damage, up to 2 times as much at maximum range. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Quarry Sense
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Chase Breath
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
